title: Atreneefo Dae
intro: Wɔ bere a na gyidi yɛ hu na na wɔn a wɔwɔ tumi hwehwɛ sɛ wobebubu gyidi mu no, akra nkumaa kuw ketewaa bi paw nea ɛbɛka wɔ mfe pii mu. Bere a woguan nea wonim nyinaa no, wohwehwee guankobea wo bepɔw bi sum a ahintaw mu na wɔde wɔn ho too Allah so koraa. Ná nea esii akyi no bɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a bere ntumi nsɛe no ama wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho no.
clues: Na yɛyɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa kuo a wɔgyee yɛn Awurade di, na Ɔmaa yɛn nkɔanim wɔ akwankyerɛ mu.
Yegyinaa yen nkurofoo anim na yepaee mu kaa se yerenmfre onyame biara da gye Allah.
Yɛhwehwɛɛ guankɔbea wɔ ɔbodan bi mu, na yɛkaa sɛ, 'Yɛn Awurade, ma yɛn mmɔborɔhunu mfiri Wo ho na kyerɛ yɛn kwan yie wɔ yɛn asɛm no mu.'
Yɛdaa mfe pii, na na owia no bɛtwe ne ho afi yɛn ɔbodan no ho na ɛrenka yɛn.
Ná yɛn kraman no atrɛw ne ho wɔ ɔbodan no ano, na ɔrewɛn yɛn te sɛ nea ɔrewɛn.
Bere a wonyanee yɛn no, yesusuw bere tenten a yɛde atra hɔ no ho, na wɔde dwetɛ sika kɔmaa yɛn mu biako sɛ ɔnkɔtɔ aduan.
